rules.why: `invoke("save_document")` and `#[tauri::command] fn save_document` are the same edge, joined by a string with no import between them. Nothing checks it until somebody clicks the button, which is the kind of obligation this tool exists for.
A `#[tauri::command]` is the application's attack surface as much as its API. Keeping them in one folder is what makes reviewing that surface a thing somebody can do.
